industry.why: Overweight, carried; the condition for Double Overweight (defensives leading for a second month with the industry's relative strength at B or better) is half met: defensives lead on all five windows, the three-month line at +6.6 points, but Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: C now, D prior, short of B. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). Three live holdings (Carlsberg 4.67%, Fevertree 2.48%, Hilton Food 4.78%, 11.93 points) read A on Thematic Fit/Momentum through this row. Counter-case: a defensive destination two months into a rotation is crowded, and no staples house view was read this week. To A if relative strength reaches B with defensives still leading at three months.

sector.why: Overweight, carried, with a China warning named. Component 1 regime, 30-Oct-26 (risk-off beneath a steady index, led now by credit and the cost of debt rather than by the artificial intelligence wash-out alone: the US ten-year above 5% after a hawkish Fed hold with two dissents for a hike, Goldman Sachs' Risk Appetite Indicator at its lowest since April 2025, euro investment-grade and high-yield yields up 30 and 90 basis points since September, Brent near $115, the French premium a record 150 basis points, Europe rotating to quality, defensives and non-AI growth, the STOXX Europe 600 1.7% from its high with breadth recovering from the bottom fifth of three years and defensives leading cyclicals at four weeks and three months; sources present 2026-W44): staples are the rotation's destination, but AB InBev's Asia-Pacific volumes fell 11% on Chinese beer demand (Outset Global, 29 October), and China is the weak sector within staples. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-30 against 2026-08-28, not week on week: B now, D prior, the market has started to pay. Two live holdings, Carlsberg (3.98%, with China exposure, Sell-side Momentum D) and Fevertree (2.00%), judged in component 4. Counter-case: the China leg is a company-level read on one brewer. Holds B with the staples industry; moves to A with it if defensives lead for a second month and the China read does not spread.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Denmark this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Beverages' Sector RS is 81 and Carlsberg's Stock RS 77, 31 and 7 points above the lines of 50 and 70.
Stock RS (3) since the Fri 6-Nov reading, Sector RS +1; both +23 to +27 since Fri 9-Oct.

About 4% to 7% of underperformance takes Stock RS below 70 (77 to 69); Beverages' Sector RS fell 38 points in 12 days in August (68 at the 31-Jul month-end to 30 on 12-Aug), more than the 32 points it needs now.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal: Carlsberg's relative price is 5.7% below its 52W high of 12-Feb (8.9% at the 30-Oct reading).
At a flat market a sell signal at Mon 30-Nov needs Carlsberg's SP at about DKK 816, 20.4% below the 10-Nov close.
Relative price has slipped from 4.4% below its high (6-Nov) and has not confirmed the SP's 5-Nov high.

items.criterion: SS Sales or SS PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero AND Stock RS below 50, read at the month-end

bullets.text: No sell signal at 30-Oct: revenue Net Upgrade Breadth +48%, PT Net Upgrade Breadth +16%, Carlsberg's Stock RS 70.
On 10-Nov revenue Net Upgrade Breadth is +64% (no cutters) and PT Net Upgrade Breadth +36%, both rising.
A sell signal at Mon 30-Nov needs Stock RS down 28 points to below 50, with a breadth measure negative again.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: No sell signal; no tranche triggered: the 30% level for all three tranches is DKK 722.05, 29.6% below the 10-Nov close.
Each tranche's highest close since purchase is the 5-Nov close of DKK 1,031.5.
A triggered tranche sells at the Tuesday session after its release, even under your one-off in/out link.

items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal at the Fri 6-Nov reading: Carlsberg's relative 200D MA rose 0.79% over the month (0.85% on 10-Nov).
The slope has steepened at each reading since 23-Oct (+0.12%, then +0.42% at 30-Oct).
None at Fri 13-Nov: relative price is 8.7% above its relative 200D MA.

items.criterion: Industry RS below 30, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal at the Fri 6-Nov reading: Consumer staples' Industry RS is 73, unchanged on 10-Nov.
Your 10-Nov note lists the "Defensives trade" among the market's current trades; Industrials and capital goods read 26.
None at Fri 13-Nov: a 44-point fall in a week has no precedent in Carlsberg's readings.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: The rules allow an add: none of Carlsberg's six Sell Criteria gives a sell signal.
The nearest, Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70: Sector RS is 31 points above 50, Stock RS 7 above 70.
Carlsberg's Stock RS below 70 with Beverages' Sector RS below 50 at Mon 30-Nov.

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: The rules allow an add: Carlsberg is 4.61% of capital now (3.98% at entry) against the 6.68% limit, leaving 2.07% of room.
The room takes one 1.67% tranche; a second could be at most 0.40%.
An SP rise shrinks the room; the upper end of your 2-4% plan does not fit.

adds.criterion: Where Carlsberg stands for an add: pulling back or basing; may be retesting or forming a volatility contraction pattern; healthily retesting or breaking out

bullets.text: None of the three: 0.6% below its 5-Nov 52W closing high, 5.0% above the rising 20D MA.
The Master Dashboard points to pulling back or basing (basing plausible, 3 of 4; healthy retest 2 of 6; volatility contraction pattern 0 of 4).
A light-volume dip beyond 3.3% towards DKK 981.8 (first stage); a hold at the rising 20D MA (third stage).

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a positive retest of a rising MA

bullets.text: Absent: the SP is 5.0% above the rising 20D MA and 12.5% to 15.6% above the longer MAs.
Your trend-health tests all pass; in February and July no retest of the 50D, 100D or 150D MA held.
At a flat SP the 20D MA reaches about DKK 995 by 16-Nov; a hold there on drying volume.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

bullets.text: Partly present: no revenue or EBITDA cutters, PT breadth +36%, peers at highs; guidance only reiterated, EPS up under 1%.
One Buy became a Hold on 9-Nov, and FY2027 EPS is still down over three and six months.
Organic EPS raises, or relative price at a new 52W high (6.1% more outperformance).
On 2-Nov you wrote: "Ergo, do not add yet… wait for a positive retest of the 50, 100 or 150 or 200D MA".
You also wrote "Add 2-4% in 2 tranches over N2W"; the 50D MA retest needs an 11.4% fall from the 10-Nov close.
Your ruling on the size and on the 20D MA as the retest line; your 10-Nov note does not mention Carlsberg.

defs.atr: average true range: each day's high to low, stretched to the previous close on a gap, as a % of the previous close; L5D the last 5 sessions, L1M and L3M the last 30 and 91 calendar days
defs.top_half: a close above the midpoint of the day's high-low range; an up day closes at or above the previous close; days with no range are left out
